requirements.title: Rabies antibody titre (FAVN/RNAT ≥ 0.5 IU/mL), 90-365 days before export

manual_checklist.title: Confirm ISO 11784/11785 microchip compatibility (or a compatible reader will accompany the animal)
manual_checklist.detail: ISO 11784/11785 compatibility is NOT inferred from the chip number; confirm the chip is ISO-compatible, or that a compatible reader will accompany the animal.

manual_checklist.title: Obtain a Singapore dog or cat licence (via PALS)
manual_checklist.detail: Owners must hold a Singapore dog OR cat licence (through the PALS portal) BEFORE applying for the import licence. Applies to both dogs and cats.

manual_checklist.title: Apply for the AVS import licence
manual_checklist.detail: Apply online (S$50/100, ~90-day validity) before travel. Present it during airline check-in. Without it the pet is refused entry or quarantined.

manual_checklist.title: Obtain a Customs In-Payment / GST permit before arrival
manual_checklist.detail: A Singapore Customs In-Payment (GST) permit must be obtained before the pet arrives. Mandatory part of the AVS import process.

manual_checklist.title: Book a border-inspection appointment (≥5 days before arrival)
manual_checklist.detail: Book the AVS border inspection, generally at least 5 days before arrival. Arriving without an appointment risks an additional fee and delay.

manual_checklist.title: Post-arrival quarantine is conditional
manual_checklist.detail: A Schedule II personal pet can AVOID post-arrival quarantine if it enters Singapore within 5 days of its owner AND has lived continuously with the owner at the same residential address for more than 6 months before import. Otherwise a minimum 10-day home quarantine applies (commercial-licence pets serve ≥10 days at the Animal Quarantine Centre). The waiver itself is authority-controlled and cannot be self-attested; confirm the quarantine arrangement.

manual_checklist.title: Airline captain's declaration (Schedule I/II)
manual_checklist.detail: Schedule I and II animals need a signed airline captain's declaration. Confirm with the carrier before travel.

manual_checklist.title: Parasite treatment 2–7 days before export
manual_checklist.detail: Internal + external parasite treatment administered 2 to 7 days before export, recorded on the health certificate. Owner/vet attestation of the window; the date is attested, not independently verified by Petra.

sources.applies_to: US-origin (Schedule II) dog/cat import to Singapore
supporting_requirements: dog OR cat licence via PALS

sources.page_title: Pet Travel From the United States to Singapore
supporting_requirements: AVS Veterinary Health Certificate + APHIS endorsement (not Form 7001)
